findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 Item 3 列示的法律程序為證券集體訴訟（class period 2024-11-07 至 2025-03-27），未列反壟斷案件；風險因子僅泛稱反壟斷法可能限制併購。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: Beginning in early March 2025, certain alleged stockholders filed putative class action complaints against the Company, Adam Foroughi, Matthew Stumpf, and/or Herald Chen asserting claims for alleged violations of Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

findings.claim: SEC 調查仍在進行（Bloomberg 2026-02 報導），範圍未公開、未對公司或高管提出指控；起因報導為違反平台夥伴服務協議以推送更多定向廣告。屬證券／資料收集監管，非反壟斷。
findings.source: The Star（Bloomberg 轉載）SEC probe involving AppLovin still active

findings.claim: 報導稱 FTC 調查 AppLovin 的用戶資料收集方式（隱私，非反壟斷）
findings.excerpt: Report: FTC has launched an investigation into AppLovin over its user data collection practices Published by admin Tags: AppLovin, FTC The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) has decided to investigate the activities of AppLovin, Bloomberg sources report.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 三次搜尋未見 DOJ／歐盟執委會反壟斷或拆分案；FTC 2025-10 報導為資料隱私調查（二手來源），無後續更新。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
